BRAHM Drop  v1.1  —  Windows
Brahm InnerBrain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  |  Developed by Sandeep Kushwah
=======================================================================

WHAT IT DOES
  Send files between your phone, Mac and Windows PC over the same Wi-Fi.
  No internet, no login, no ads. Files never leave your network.

HOW TO RUN
  1. Double-click  "BRAHM Drop.exe"
     (On an ARM Windows PC such as Snapdragon, use "BRAHM Drop (ARM).exe".)
  2. The app window / console opens and your browser shows the BRAHM Drop screen.
  3. The FIRST time, Windows asks "Allow BRAHM Drop on your network?"
     -> Tick "Private networks" and click Allow. (Needed so other devices see it.)

CONNECT YOUR PHONE
  * On the app's "Receive" screen you'll see a QR code and an address like
        http://192.168.x.x:53330
  * On your phone (same Wi-Fi) open the camera, scan the QR, and the BRAHM Drop
    page opens in the phone browser. No app install needed.
  * Tap this PC in the list, choose files -> they arrive on the PC.
  * To send FROM the PC to the phone, keep that phone page open and pick it in
    the PC's device list.

WHERE FILES ARE SAVED
  Received files go to:  C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\BRAHM Drop
  (change it on the Settings screen)

STOP THE APP
  Close the window, or press Ctrl+C in the console.

NOTE
  This build is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may show "Windows protected
  your PC". Click "More info" -> "Run anyway". A signed release can be provided.
